steps.name: Epilogue ~ Calm Before the Storm
steps.objective: Find out who has come to see [Talos] in 「Knossos」.

lines.text: (On a night shrouded in darkness in Knossos, Talos frowns as he looks up at the sky.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: What is it about Knossos that attracts so much attention? First the goddess' follower, then a demon. And now...

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: ...Even the Talos I crushed has come back.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Talos, I know why you woke. But I would prefer you never did that again...
Step aside now.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: You haven't shown yourself for so long. If you've come now...
Yes, that's right. I've come to speak with your younger brother.
(A large staff reaches out of the darkness and taps Talos on the shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I won't fall for some cheap trick. This power... Ngh... What is it...?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: This is...
A piece of the night soon to come. The power mastered by the sinner of Eastland... 'Binding.'

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Damn you... Daphne...
(The woman called Daphne smiles brightly and withdraws her staff. As she looks up at the towering Talos, her unusually long ears twitch.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I wish to speak with Talos. Before Lord Minos senses my presence and flies into a rage.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Very well. I'll step aside.
(Talos lowers his head. When he opens his eyes again, Daphne quietly calls his name.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Talos.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Lady Daphne.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: One question. Did you awaken Pasiphae and Lord Minos?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Yes. I felt I should. But my brother interfered again, and I couldn't get them out.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I couldn't bring back the golem.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: That is all right. Thanks to you, that child was able to come here as well.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: What will become of the sinner of Eastland's plans? What effect will they have on the night you await, Lady Daphne...?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Who can say? Hehe. Why don't we wait and see? There is more than one night, and nights are long...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Talos, you must be tired. Rest for a while.
(Daphne extends her staff and taps Talos on the shoulder. He immediately loses consciousness and falls to the ground.)
(After checking on the fallen Talos, Daphne quietly turns her gaze to the night sky.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I helped the sinner you sent, as you wished. But I never knew that choice would tighten a noose around Knossos and our people.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: So now I will act as I wish.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Though the night that awaits us rests in the hands of the one who accompanies the goddess destined to face the sinner...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: And you. Were you waiting for me?

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: Um... Thank you for saving me...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Think nothing of it. You almost foolishly became a key. Deimos nearly arrived sooner than expected because of you... But it is all right.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: So keep running, as you have been. Keep struggling. That will make it entertaining...

lines.speaker: 소녀
lines.text: ...You want that too?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Of course. You, I, and they are all the same kind... But I don't want it from you just yet.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: So...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Run, and wait for the night you are finally caught... Please! For my amusement!!
